planted.description: The ^/manage access_control rule is limited to methods POST, PUT, DELETE and ManageController has no #[IsGranted], so GET /manage/customers (src/Controller/ManageController.php:18-24) lists every customer's name, email and address to anonymous visitors.
receipt() resolves Order from the URL id and checks only ROLE_USER, not ownership. Any signed-in user can read any order's receipt (customer name, email, address).
search() concatenates the category query parameter into andWhere() DQL. Unauthenticated DQL injection on GET /products.
update() deserializes the JSON body into the current User with OBJECT_TO_POPULATE and no groups, so setRoles(), setEmail() and setApiToken() are reachable. A user can grant themselves ROLE_STAFF.

The paragraphs filter is declared is_safe html but wraps the input in

and nl2br() without escaping it. Applied to member.bio on the public member page (templates/member/show.html.twig:5), it is stored XSS.

importImage() fetches the posted image_url with HttpClient (no NoPrivateNetworkHttpClient, redirects followed) and writes the response under public/, so staff can read internal services or cloud metadata.
export() builds a shell command line with Process::fromShellCommandline() from the name request field (ManageController.php:46). Command injection for staff.
GET /api/members/{id} returns $this->json($member) with no groups, which serializes every getter of User: password hash, apiToken, roles, email and address. Public.

decoys.description: The name filter concatenates % into the parameter value, not the DQL: andWhere('p.name LIKE :term')->setParameter(...). Safe.

orderBy('p.priceInPence', $priceOrder) takes the direction from the price query parameter, but doctrine/orm 3.7 (the installed version) validates string directions in QueryBuilder::getSortDirection() and throws on anything but asc/desc. Safe on this version (it was concatenated up to ORM 3.6).
allow_extra_fields only suppresses the extra-fields error; extra keys are never mapped onto User. Safe.
{{ product_data|json_encode|raw }} inside <script>: json_encode escapes /, so a description containing </script> can't close the tag, and the JSON is a JS literal. Safe.
cancel() has no voter or #[IsGranted], but ^/orders requires ROLE_USER, it checks a CSRF token, and it loads the order with findOneBy(['id' => $id, 'customer' => $this->getUser()]). Safe.
